UX CONSIDERATIONS
DISCOVERABILITY
First-time users may not know cmd+K exists. Consider a subtle hint in the UI
(toolbar icon, onboarding tooltip) that teaches the shortcut without being
intrusive.
EMPTY STATES
When no results match, show helpful message with suggestions: "No results for
'xyz'. Try searching for commands, files, or settings. " Avoid dead-ends.
FOCUS MANAGEMENT
On open, focus moves to search input. On close, focus returns to previously
focused element. Trap focus within modal while open (critical for
accessibility).

SEARCH LATENCY
Results should appear within 50ms to feel instant. Use debouncing (150-200ms)
to avoid excessive filtering on rapid typing. Show loading skeleton if async
search exceeds 200ms.
KEYBOARD NAVIGATION
Arrow keys must wrap (bottom to top, top to bottom). Home/End jump to
first/last. Type-ahead should not steal focus from search input.
RECENT /FREQUENT
Prioritize recently used commands at top. Consider a "frecency" algorithm
(frequency + recency) for smarter ordering. Cap recent items to 3-5 to avoid
clutter.
